segments.en: The four species: esrog — the heart — the flame of the heart always ascending of itself through the rapid movements of the G-dly intellect in the dimension of face. lulav — the spine — through which the drop of intellect flows from concealment to revelation, from encompassing to encompassing to internalized. hadas — the eyes — drawing the mental faculties from encompassing to internalized — the dimension of "open my eyes and I will behold wonders of Your Torah." arova — the mouth — the dimension of "from His mouth come knowledge and understanding" — for when one merits attaining the encompassing lights, one must reveal the illumination of one's knowledge to others and make known the virtues to G-d's people — which is only possible through words of one's mouth.

segments.he: עיין בליקוטי הלכות הלכות ספר תורה הלכה ב' מבאר שם כל ענין ר"ה יו"כ סוכות ע"פ מאמר הנ"ל ועיין גם כן בליקוטי הלכות חושן משפט הלכות מתנה הלכהה' מבואר שם ג"כ ענין ר"ה יו"כ ע"פ מאמר הנ"ל לכן אמרתי לקצר:
segments.en: On Sh'mini Atzeres — the union of the Matron face to face — a great illumination of the supernal intellect is drawn upon all Israel — the face of light — and the joy and flaming of the heart is exceedingly great. And all Israel ascend to the Torah: "and there arose no prophet in Israel like Moshe, whom G-d knew face to face" — for he merited completely attaining the face of light. And one begins Bereishis — in the wisdom (b'chochma) — for the creation was for the sake of drawing this intellect, this wisdom, this face-to-face encounter into the world.
